title: Illustrative migration behaviour inventory
method: A fictional inventory starts with 40 workflows and adds 12 exception paths plus 8 batch dependencies: 60 identified behaviours. The 50% inventory increase is not a time or cost forecast.
alt: Illustrative migration behaviour inventory. Initial workflows: 40 behaviours; Exception paths found: 12 behaviours; Batch dependencies found: 8 behaviours. Illustrative inputs.
